# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 release** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 brings the Skia m152 renderer and new cross-platform GPU capabilities. This release adds Graphite bindings and asynchronous GPU pixel readback, expands Vulkan support, and resolves several native lifetime issues.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent servicing and upstream correctness fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))
- **Additional m151 fixes included** — Carries forward upstream m151 stability and browser bug fixes for consumers upgrading from earlier release lines. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Provides managed bindings for the Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn Graphite backends. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous GPU pixel readback added** — SKImage and SKSurface now offer backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel and region lifetime issues corrected** — Roots native sources during SKPixmap subset and With operations and while enumerating SKRegion spans, preventing use-after-free failures. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Native allocations are released on failure and reset** — Disposes raster-image pixel buffers after failed creation and replaces the previous uniform buffer when SKRuntimeEffectUniforms is reset. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))
- **Common managed operations allocate less** — Reduces copies and temporary allocations when saving SKData, converting four-byte tags, reading encoded text, and looking up runtime-effect uniforms. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))

## Platform

- **Vulkan Silk.NET package production restored** — Restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and adds native-symbol package generation for Apple platforms. ([#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))
- **Nano Server gains FreeType font support** — The Nano Server native assets use FreeType to provide font rendering support. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves shaping performance by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy and fixes the non-memory-backed stream lifetime used to create HarfBuzz blobs.
